negative_cases.rule: operand mutation changes decoded values, not width/pc_delta; opcode mutation changes the dispatched handler and is outside the operand contract

opcode_mutation.note: opcode byte at opcode_pc selects BD[dispatchState][opcode] (JS) / image-table entry (WASM); operand contract is keyed to the dispatched opcode, not byte position

negative_cases.rule: a handler can write context.P explicitly, so pc_delta is not a straight-line increment; the decoder increment must compose with the explicit write
